name: win
description: The scoped country wins the game

name: add_blocker
description: Adds a blocker to a colony carrier, with some control over what it is set to block (add_deposit will add a random planetary deposit to block)

name: abort_special_project
description: Aborts a specific special project for the country, removing it from the situation log

name: set_country_flag
description: Sets an arbitrarily-named flag on the scoped country
usage: set_country_flag = <key> (note: one can use e.g. my_flag@from to track relationships between objects)

name: add_experience
description: Adds a sum of experience points to the scoped leader

name: abort_situation
description: Destroys a situation in right hand side event target, firing on_abort (use to cancel and fire that effect)

name: accept_covenant
description: Accepts covenant proposition with Shroud Patron.

name: activate_crisis_progression
description: Activates crisis progression for the country

name: activate_fog_machine
description: Creates cloud effect at every star system controlled by the country

name: activate_gateway
description: Activates the gateway associated with a megastructure.
